propositions: Bedrock must demonstrate payload and tool parity with direct Anthropic before becoming a first-class LLM provider in the rebar gate system.
The Bedrock provider inference-profile IDs are invokable in AWS account 896586841071/us-east-1 for both standard (sonnet-4-6) and frontier (opus-4-8) model slots.

A paired corpus run of 30 gold-labeled eval cases across both providers showed Bedrock achieves identical system prompt, messages, tools, and max_tokens payloads with Anthropic, differing only in model ID and envelope format.
The temperature capability difference (withdrawn from opus, sent to sonnet) is model-driven not provider-driven, symmetrically handled by the existing supports_temperature override on both providers.
Provider routing is clean: zero non-Bedrock calls recorded across 84 case-runs per arm per slot in the REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally.
